headline: Three ways to give
lead: Cash gifts advertise out to SCAD Giving. Hardware moves through the wishlist and the two forms on this page.

paths.title: Technology Fund
paths.body: Give through SCAD Giving to the STEC Technology Fund.

paths.title: Design Tomorrow
paths.body: Sponsor at Title, Presenting, Track, or Partner through SCAD Giving.

paths.title: Hardware
paths.body: Pledge an in-kind item or ask Advancement about a line on the wishlist.

wishlist.headline: Hardware wishlist
wishlist.lead: Categories only until STEC and Advancement lock the approved list. Photos forthcoming.

items.name: Compute workstations
items.use: Student production seats — GPU class machines for realtime, film, and simulation work.

items.name: XR kits
items.use: Headsets and tracking for immersive classes and industry reviews.

items.name: Capture
items.use: Cameras, volume, and body / face capture for performance and spatial work.

items.name: Audio
items.use: Interfaces, mics, and monitoring for game, film, and installation sound.

items.name: Fabrication
items.use: Printers, cutters, and shop tools that turn digital work into objects.

items.name: Networking and storage
items.use: Switches, NAS, and backup so classes can move large media without friction.
